categories.distribution: Canonical Workflow implementation. Copied byte-for-byte into the payload and installed into every managed target repository.

rules.rationale: D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): adds TOOLING_AMBIENT_EXCLUDED_PATHS = {.workflow-manager/installation.json}, an exact-path, release-derived terminal fallback that classify_path and classify_path_implementation_stage consult only after every declared classification has failed, immediately before the UnclassifiedPathError raise. The frozen declared-classification semantics are untouched: a declaration still decides first, the constant never enters a hashed classification set, and the path never existed in any Workflow payload or in the upstream repository the frozen classifier was written for -- so every digest 2.5.1 could compute is byte-identical and only a digest that raised because a committed workflow_manager update rewrote the installation record now returns (the legacy-item half of v2.4.0-001). D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): resolve_feedback_dir becomes the one authoritative resolver keyed on the durable feedback_layout stamp -- "scoped" items resolve .ai-review/<id>/feedback by construction, items without the stamp (or without a state entry or state file) keep the unchanged scoped-else-flat rule, an undecidable state file or unknown value refuses (FeedbackLayoutUndecidableError/UnknownFeedbackLayoutError); adds resolve_feedback_layout, ensure_feedback_dir (called by mark_functional_review_consumed), resolve_feedback_path_contract and the --resolve-feedback-path CLI; assert_feedback_not_owned_by_other_work_item gains an optional state for the bounded terminal-owner relaxation (legacy writers only); adds assert_manual_feedback_names_work_item. D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): the plan stage's recoverable generator -- plan_stage_staging_paths, seed_plan_review_inputs and resolve_plan_review_inputs_dir (author inputs read from .ai-review/<id>/plan-inputs/, seeded read-only from current/, else stubbed), capture_plan_stage_pin(pin_dir=), write_manifest_with_verified_identifiers_for_work_item(bundle_dir=, pin_dir=) (the work-item/base binding check still runs against the live current/MANIFEST.md), and finalize_staged_plan_bundle_generation (promote on success and clear REJECTED; on failure discard the staging area -- no withdraw_bundle, no REJECTED marker: the deliberate WFR-67 revision). finalize_bundle_generation's checks move unchanged into _closing_bundle_generation_check, so the implementation/post-fix in-place path and its withdrawal are byte-for-byte unchanged in behavior. Also read_plan_stage_manifest_fields, compute_archived_bundle_id, parse_feedback_review_content_id, and the --staging-token CLI flag. No hashed identity changes (INV-8). D-Plan-Approval-Closure (CP5): resolve_plan_stage_approval_commit_paths returns every declared plan_stage.protected_paths entry (plan, registry, mapping first), WORKFLOW_STATE.json, the unchanged conditional artifacts-declaration member, and the removals (protected under HEAD's committed declaration, tracked at HEAD, absent from the current declaration and the worktree); PlanApprovalCommitPlan gains defaulted protected_paths/removal_paths; adds read_plan_stage_manifest_base_commit and read_plan_stage_manifest_protected_paths; compute_review_content_id_plan_stage_at_commit is documented as accepting any tree-ish (the write-tree proof). No hashed identity changes (INV-8).

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): adds TestToolingAmbientExcludedPaths -- fallback classification at both stages with a 2.5.1 control arm, explicit-protected precedence, sibling fail-closed paths, hashed-projection invariance, and digest invariance with the previously raising digests equal to their pre-update recorded values. Additive only: every pre-existing test is unmodified. D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): adds TestFeedbackLayout (scoped-by-construction resolution, ensure_feedback_dir, the unchanged legacy rule for a legacy entry/no entry/no state file, undecidable-state and unknown-value refusals, no cross-item collision, the terminal-owner relaxation and its bounds, the per-item consumed marker, CLI/function equality for all three layouts, and the manual-record Work item: refusal). TestBundleLayoutResolver, TestFunctionalReviewConsumedMarker and TestReviewImplementationWritebackCrossWorkItemIsolation are re-pointed by docstring to their legacy scope; no assertion is removed.

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): adds TestImplementingEntryReachableAfterInstallationRecordUpdate -- a 2.3.1-shaped item stays implementing_entry_reachable after a committed installation-record change, with a 2.5.1 control arm that raises UnclassifiedPathError. Additive only: every pre-existing test is unmodified. D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): adds TestFeedbackLayoutStamp -- fresh items and remediation children are stamped "scoped", resume never stamps or changes the field, validate_state accepts absent/"scoped" and refuses any other value. D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): adds TestPlanReviewBindingValidation, TestPublishPlanRevisionTwoStage, TestRouteWorkItemPlanStageAllowList, TestBindPlanReviewBundle, TestWithdrawPlanReview, TestConsumedPlanReviewBindingWriters, TestEnsurePlanReviewBindingMarker and TestAssertApplyPlanReviewFeedback. NOT additive only: pre-existing tests that pinned the 2.5.1 behavior this checkpoint deliberately changes are re-pointed, none deleted -- the publish's phase flip (now mirror-only for "2.1"/"2.2", the bind writes the phase), transition_to_awaiting_local_plan_review (now asserted to refuse, with the bind driving the same edge), route_work_item resume fixtures moved from IMPLEMENTING to a plan-stage phase, and TestPersistedPhaseWriterCensus (AWAITING_LOCAL_PLAN_REVIEW's sole writer is bind_plan_review_bundle; withdraw_plan_review writes REVISING_PLAN/AMENDING_PLAN). D-Plan-Approval-Closure (CP5): adds TestPlanApprovalClosureUnits (the amend gate's classification, the named errors at both stages, the explicit expected id, journal removal_paths validation including a 2.5.1 journal without the field, the manifest readers, staging a deletion, the git-mv remedy). Additive only. D-Repo-Global-Lifecycle (CP6): TestCrossWorktreeAmendmentClaimResidualXModelR9B1, which pinned the open v2.4.0-002 boundary, is inverted and renamed TestCrossWorktreeAmendmentClaimRaceIsClosed (tests 1-4, real linked worktrees and real processes racing in both orders). TestAmendmentClaimRaceRealProcesses keeps both same-worktree races through the new entry point (test 16; a claim refused because the amendment won now reports AmendmentInFlightError). TestRequestPlanAmendment's unit tests call the pure mutator holding (9), plus a no-bypass test. New: TestRepoGlobalLifecycleClaimAndAmendment (5, 6, 11, 12, 13a, 13e), TestAmendmentWitnessCrashRecovery (7 with SIGKILL, 7a, 9 with SIGKILL, 10), TestLifecycleLockIsAPureSource (23), TestAmendmentWitnessUpgradeBootstrap (13, 13b-13i; the version helper pinned against a verbatim copy of release._version_key and against the real one when importable), TestAmendmentBootstrapResolutionFork (20, 21's bootstrap half) and TestAmendmentResolutionReservation (8, 13i, 17's core, 19, 21, 22(c)-(e), 24, 27, 28, and the journal's live-claim refusal) against real plan-approval journals. NOT additive only: four pre-existing tests that acquired a lease to stand in for a live holder now release it at the end (the process-local held-set would otherwise carry it into later tests), and TestGlobalLockOrderItem372h's docstrings restate the census counts; no assertion is removed. Plus two regression tests for the review fixes (the unreadable-requester literal, and the updated worktree naming its own unrecorded amendment).

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): the Computing review_content_id section gains the classification paragraph naming the one release-derived fallback, where it sits in the classification order, and what stays fail-closed. D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): "Bundle structure" restates AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch to the working-tree anchor -- the base-plus-current-plus-declaration pathspec union, --no-renames, the provenance preamble, and its placement after MANIFEST.md -- and states it stays convenience only. D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): "Bundle location" gains the normative "Feedback directory" subsection -- the durable stamp, the scoped/legacy/refused resolution, ensure_feedback_dir, the --resolve-feedback-path contract for external tools, the bounded ownership-guard relaxation and the manual-record binding; the flat-fallback sentences are narrowed to the bundle directory and the Feedback protocol's location note is restated. D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): the plan-inputs/ layout, the new "Plan-stage staging generation and <plan_inputs_dir>" subsection, and the plan-stage revision of WFR-67 (a failed plan generation withdraws nothing and writes no REJECTED marker), stated as deliberate.

D-Tooling-Ambient-Classification (CP1): new design section carrying the problem, the decision, its release-derived authority, the identity-stability argument, the fail-closed boundary, the justification relative to the frozen plan-stage classifier, and the rejected alternatives. D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): the section's AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch paragraph gains a "Working-tree anchor" subsection -- why the ..HEAD form was always empty, the pathspec union and its reachable deletion/rename shapes, the provenance preamble, and consistency with the reviewed bytes. D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): new design section -- problem, the stamp, the one resolver, directory creation, the external CLI contract, the bounded guard relaxation, manual-record binding, why legacy items are not moved, the mechanical downgrade evidence (2.5.1's validate_state ignores the key), and rejected alternatives. D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): D-Plan-Revision-Publication revised (mirror-only for two-stage items; WFR-65 kept) and a new D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding section stating the WFR-67 change as a deliberate revision (LPR-R3-002). D-Plan-Approval-Closure (CP5): new design section -- problem (the fixed member set, the pre-commit verifier input), decision items 1-7, recovery, identity stability and rejected alternatives. D-Repo-Global-Lifecycle (CP6): the global partial order gains primitive (9) and five edges -- nine primitives, sixteen edges, nine blocking and seven non-blocking, blocking sources {1, 5, 8, 9} and targets {2, 3, 6} -- in the fenced edge table, the primitive list, the totals, the blocking list, the code-derivable note (including (9)->(3), which the census found and the plan's hand count missed) and the acyclicity argument; the (2)->(8) paragraph and D-Plan-Amendment-1's narrowed bullet record the residual closed repository-wide; a new D-Repo-Global-Lifecycle section (problem, decision items 1-10, lock order, residual, forward compatibility).

D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2, v2.4.0-003): the AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch block drops ..HEAD and diffs amendment_base_commit against the working tree (--no-renames), over the sorted union of the plan_stage.protected_paths declared at amendment_base_commit, the ones declared now and <id>-artifacts.json itself; it gains a provenance preamble (work_item_id, amendment_id, amendment_base_commit, plan_revision, review_content_id) and moves after --write-manifest so the preamble can carry the manifest's review_content_id. The file stays outside current/ and outside both identities; the archive line and every other block are unchanged. D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): the plan stage assembles into .ai-review/<id>/current.staging-<token>/current/ with a .pin.staging-<token>/ pin, its archive and AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch inside the staging area (the archive's member root stays the bare literal current, item 341), copies the author files from plan-inputs/ (seed_plan_review_inputs), finalizes with --staging-token, and removes the staging area on any exit before promotion; leftovers of an interrupted generation are removed at the start. The implementation, post-fix and functional-review stages are unchanged. Implementation review round 1 fixes: the AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch diff is captured and written as bytes (a non-UTF-8 protected file no longer aborts the plan-stage generation), with every configuration-sensitive option pinned on the command line (--literal-pathspecs, --no-ext-diff, --no-textconv, --no-color, explicit a/ b/ prefixes, --no-renames, --binary), and the archive includes AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch only at the plan stage, so an implementation or post-fix archive never ships a stale plan-stage copy.

D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): adds TestPrepareAiReviewShAmendmentDiffWorkingTreeAnchor, driving the real prepare-ai-review.sh in scratch repositories -- uncommitted plan edit (with a ..HEAD control arm), untracked new protected file with the index restored, dropped-and-deleted path, rename as deletion plus new file, dropped-but-kept changed and unchanged paths, artifacts declaration absent at the base, non-protected edits absent, archive member byte-identity, bundle_id invariance, removal after resolution, preamble fields, and git apply --check at amendment_base_commit. Additive only: every pre-existing test is unmodified. D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): adds TestPrepareAiReviewShPlanStageStaging -- promotion from plan-inputs/, both section 3.3 failure variants leaving the previous current/, archive and .pin byte-identical with no REJECTED marker or staging leftover, a pre-existing REJECTED marker surviving failure and cleared by success, current/ seeding with a location-independent bundle_id, seed sources/mode/symlink refusal, leftover removal, and staging-token validation. Additive only. Implementation review round 1: adds non-UTF-8 and binary protected content (an applicable patch), byte-stability under a hostile GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, and an implementation-stage archive that excludes a stale AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch; the class's _generate/_assert_applies_at helpers gain byte and environment parameters.

D-Plan-Amendment-5 revision (CP2): step 4's note on AMENDMENT_DIFF.patch states the working-tree anchor, so the patch shows the still-uncommitted amended plan. The generator-mention wording workflow_integration_test.py's census pins (mention-only, no run/rerun invocation) is kept. D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): one sentence noting the request also writes the CONSUMED plan_review_binding record for a two-stage item. D-Repo-Global-Lifecycle (CP6): step 1's race paragraph describes the closure across every linked worktree (the lifecycle lock and the amendment witness) and the mixed-release residual; step 2 calls request_plan_amendment_transaction (a direct state_transaction of the pure mutator is refused) and names each lifecycle refusal and its remedy, including the evidence-bound clear literal. The mention-only generator wording is unchanged.

D-Feedback-Layout (CP3; first overlay replacement of workflow_state.py): route_work_item's fresh-id branch and create_remediation_child_work_item stamp feedback_layout: "scoped" at creation (never on resume, never back-filled), and _validate_work_item (validate_state) refuses any present feedback_layout value other than "scoped" with UnknownFeedbackLayoutError. Nothing else changes. D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): separates "the revision exists" from "the revision is review-ready" for TWO_STAGE_PLAN_REVIEW_VERSIONS items. publish_plan_revision becomes mirror-only (phase unchanged) and writes the new plan_review_binding record's PUBLISHED fact from a required review_content_id keyword; it and route_work_item's resume branch run only at PLANNING/REVISING_PLAN/AMENDING_PLAN (PlanReviewInProgressError at a ready phase, PlanReviewPhaseNotPlanStageError elsewhere). record_local_plan_review/record_manual_plan_review REVISE and request_plan_amendment write CONSUMED from their own inputs. New: bind_plan_review_bundle (the sole writer of AWAITING_LOCAL_PLAN_REVIEW, legitimate only against the freshly re-read record), withdraw_plan_review, ensure_plan_review_binding_marker (the INV-7 legacy entry marker), verify_plan_review_bundle with cause-named refusals, plan_review_publication_status (section 5.3 item 6's total table) and its read-only --plan-review-publication-status CLI, the readers' assert_plan_review_bundle_bound/validate_local_plan_review_preconditions_bound, assert_plan_review_withdrawal_allowed, assert_apply_plan_review_feedback, and validate_state's INV-3 shape check of the record. transition_to_awaiting_local_plan_review is retired (always raises PlanReviewWriterRetiredError). "1"-governed behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged. D-Plan-Approval-Closure (CP5): resolve_fresh_plan_approval_members (empty-index precondition naming the staged-git-mv remedy, the member set, per-member freshness against the bound bundle's capture or its MANIFEST base_commit blob, removal members neither captured nor declared; every failure ReviewedContentDriftError), assert_plan_approval_member_set_unchanged (step 5's in-window re-resolution), prove_plan_approval_index_closure (git write-tree plus the plan-stage identity at that tree, before any commit), verify_plan_approval_commit (the one post-commit verification, deriving the work item from the committed state; two-sided path-set check via assert_committed_plan_approval_closure), classify_post_commit_verification_failure (the amend gate: TREE_CONTENT vs RECORD_OR_INPUT), verify_post_approval_manifest_match's MissingApprovalRecordError and optional explicit expected_review_content_id (CommittedApprovalRecordMismatchError), stage_plan_approval_commit_paths staging an absent member as a deletion, and the journal's optional removal_paths. 5 named errors. D-Repo-Global-Lifecycle (CP6; closes v2.4.0-002): primitive (9), lifecycle_lock -- a per-work-item flock at <git-common-dir>/ai-workflow/checkpoint-claims/<token>.lifecycle.lock, a pure source enforced by a process-local held-set (_held_primitives) every existing flock and lease now registers in (LifecycleLockOrderError). The amendment witness <token>.amendment.json (OPEN/RESOLVING/RESOLVED/NONE; tempfile plus os.replace; torn, symlinked or unknown-shaped refuses) with amendment_request_projection_sha256 and amendment_resolution_projection_sha256; the mixed-release lag probe (installation-record workflow_version compared numerically by workflow_release_version_key; bare entries skipped); the upgrade-bootstrap scan (request and resolution fork checks at every shared seq, the legacy Workflow-Plan-Approval trailer comparison, the NONE sentinel suppressed while any worktree lags); the provable-orphan tests for OPEN and RESOLVING with the evidence-bound clear literals (clear_amendment_witness, clear_amendment_resolution); and the fixed predicate list (_evaluate_lifecycle). claim_checkpoint now runs (9) -> state_lock -> witness check -> phase check -> _claim_or_refuse; adopt_claim and absent-claim take_over_claim take (9) before (6)/(5) (the takeover's guarded window is extracted unchanged into _take_over_claim_window). request_plan_amendment refuses unless (9) is held (LifecycleLockNotHeldError); request_plan_amendment_transaction is the one entry point and publishes the OPEN witness before the state. The resolution side: reserve_amendment_resolution (step 4d), assert_amendment_resolution_held (6a1), advance_amendment_witness (6c1), release_amendment_resolution (after 6b), and stage_plan_approval_members with first_commit/amend_recovery modes. apply_plan_approval records resolved_review_content_id (2.5.1's validate_state has no amendment_history entry-key check, so it ignores the key); open_plan_approval_journal refuses an amendment-resolving transaction while a checkpoint claim is live. 11 named errors under LifecycleRefusalError. The IllegalCheckpointStartPhaseError, AmendmentCheckpointActiveError and claim_checkpoint docstrings restate the closed residual. Review fixes before commit: an unreadable state file makes the OPEN orphan test undecidable (literal offered, and clearable), the impossible same-token reservation case refuses as INV-3 (AmendmentWitnessUnavailableError), a rollback always restores previous (never absent), and _unrecorded_local_amendment names a pre-2.6.0 amendment in the evaluating worktree's own state that the witness does not record.

D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): the feedback_dir() helper is re-pointed -- the matrix item is created through route_work_item, so it asserts the scoped layout and creates the directory through ensure_feedback_dir, the same call every production writer makes. No scenario changes. D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): the Item driver follows 2.6.0's command order -- stage, publish the fresh id, write author inputs to plan-inputs/, generate, verify and bind -- gains request_amendment/amend_plan and amendment-aware approve_plan, and gives every plan document one anchor pair per checkpoint. Rows that re-planned mid-implementation through 2.5.1's in-place re-publish (B13, B14, F4) are re-pointed through /request-plan-amendment, the one route 2.6.0 sanctions (B13 also asserts the in-place route's refusal); A1-A4 and C7 assert the bind, not the publish, writes AWAITING_LOCAL_PLAN_REVIEW; A4 asserts the revised WFR-67 (staging discarded, no REJECTED marker). New scenario classes cover the CP4 test list against real repositories. None deleted. D-Plan-Approval-Closure (CP5): Item.approve_plan becomes a command-shaped driver of /approve-review plan steps 2-6d with the command's real data flow (step 2's bound-bundle check, step 4a's fresh member set, step 5's re-resolution, step 6.3a's proof, step 6a's verify_plan_approval_commit and amend gate, step 6b's rollback) and a resumable complete_plan_approval -- no hand-built post-state; every pre-existing row runs through it unchanged. Adds PlanApprovalClosureMembers, PlanApprovalClosureFreshness, PlanApprovalClosureProof and PlanApprovalCommittedTruth covering every CP5 test bullet, including real pre-commit hooks for the amend gate. D-Repo-Global-Lifecycle (CP6): the command-shaped driver gains step 4d (reserve_amendment_resolution, rolled back through 6b on refusal), stage_plan_approval_members in first_commit mode at step 5 and amend_recovery mode at 6a1 after assert_amendment_resolution_held, 6b's journal-token capture before the rollback and release_amendment_resolution after it, and the 6c1 advance before 6d, with hook seams at each step boundary; request_amendment goes through request_plan_amendment_transaction (optionally committing the state, request-plan-amendment.md step 3); Scratch.attach/Scratch.worktree and Item.attach drive linked worktrees and worker processes. Every pre-existing row runs through the extended driver unchanged. New RepoGlobalLifecycleAcrossWorktrees (tests 8, 17 in both orders with real processes, 18 for a different and an identical plan, 22(a)/(b)/(e), 23, 25 in four variants, 26, 28 attached/detached with the only-current-token regression), driving /approve-review plan in real worker processes that pause or SIGKILL at a named step.

D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): every hard-coded .ai-review/feedback/ path (REVIEWING_PLAN exit, REVISING_PLAN entry, implementation-review allowed actions and exit, functional-review exit and entry, the optional-reviewer paragraph, Feedback file locations) becomes <feedback_dir>, with one normative definition under Feedback file locations pointing at REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md "Feedback directory". D-Plan-Review-Bundle-Binding (CP4): the bind, not the publish, writes AWAITING_LOCAL_PLAN_REVIEW; the withdrawal edge from each ready phase; plan-stage BLOCK resolved by re-review of unchanged content or an edit plus withdrawal.

D-Feedback-Layout (CP3): the invariants list gains a Feedback location bullet (scoped-by-construction for new items, legacy resolution kept, the --resolve-feedback-path CLI).
